_provenance.notes: Updated noise_rss and snr for 16-term noise budget. Signal, shot, dark_shot, read, quantization unchanged. New terms: background_shot (269.1 e-), nearfield_shot (686.0 e-) now contribute to RSS.

signal_e.provenance: hand calculation: integral of QE * L_post_optics * A_collect * Omega_pixel * (lambda/hc) dlambda * t_int; cross-checked against test_chain_extended.py::test_photoelectrons_positive

e_rate_per_s.provenance: hand calculation: signal_e / t_int = 105771.65 / 0.005; verified via stage_outputs

A_collect.provenance: hand calculation: pi/4 * 0.30^2 = 0.070686 m^2; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_A_collect

Omega_pixel.provenance: hand calculation: (18e-6)^2 / 1.20^2 = 2.25e-10 sr; verified in test_chain_extended.py::test_Omega_pixel

noise_shot.provenance: hand calculation: sqrt(signal_e) = sqrt(105771.65) = 325.226; Poisson statistics

noise_dark_shot.provenance: hand calculation: sqrt(dark_rate * t_int) = sqrt(100 * 0.005) = sqrt(0.5) = 0.7071

noise_rss.provenance: RSS of all 16 noise terms: dominated by nearfield_shot (686.0), signal_shot (325.2), background_shot (269.1)
